# Stats & ADR — Technical Reference

Two small layout-only MDX components shipped together to complete the
planning-doc first-slice pitch (see `PLANNING_COMPONENTS.md` §First-slice).
Neither has a data layer — they're pure JSX wrappers styled with
Tailwind + shadcn tokens + datagrid's `TONE_CLASS`.

- Package: `@filemark/mdx` (`packages/mdx-viewer/src/components/`)
- Files: `Stats.tsx`, `ADR.tsx`
- Showcase: `examples/stats-adr-full.md` (10 sections)
- Deps: zero new — reuses `@filemark/datagrid`'s `TONE_CLASS` + `StatusTone`.

---

## 1. `<Stats>` / `<Stat>` — KPI card grid

### Authoring

```mdx
<Stats cols="4">
  <Stat title="MRR" value="$128,400" delta="+12.4%" description="vs last month" />
  <Stat title="Active users" value="3,210" delta="-2.1%" />
  <Stat title="NPS" value="42" delta="+5" />
  <Stat title="Churn" value="1.8%" delta="-0.3%" intent="success" />
</Stats>
```

### `<Stats>` attrs

| Attr | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `cols` | `auto` | `2` / `3` / `4` / `5` / `6` — explicit column count. `auto` is responsive 1/2/3/4 at sm/lg/xl. |

### `<Stat>` attrs

| Attr | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `title` (alias: `label`) | — | Small uppercase eyebrow above the value. |
| `value` | — | The big number / text — any string. |
| `delta` | — | Change indicator. `+` prefix → up/green, `-` → down/red. `0` / no sign → flat/muted. |
| `description` (alias: `caption`) | — | Secondary muted caption below the delta. |
| `intent` | auto | Override tone: `success` / `warn` / `danger` / `info` / `muted` / `primary`. Used when "down is good" (e.g. latency). |
| `trend` | auto | Override arrow only: `up` / `down` / `flat`. |
| `href` | — | Wrap the card in a link. Renders a hover ring. |

### Tone inference

If `intent=` isn't set:

- `delta` starts with `+` → `success` + up arrow
- `delta` starts with `-` (or Unicode minus) → `danger` + down arrow
- `delta` is `0` / blank / zero-valued → `muted` + flat arrow
- Otherwise — parse as number, fallback to muted

---

## 2. `<ADR>` — Architecture Decision Record block

### Authoring

```mdx
<ADR status="accepted" id="ADR-007" date="2026-04-23" title="Use recharts for @filemark/chart">

### Context
…

### Decision
…

### Consequences
…

</ADR>
```

### Attrs

| Attr | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `proposed` | `proposed` / `accepted` / `rejected` / `deprecated` / `superseded`. |
| `id` | — | Short identifier — rendered as a mono code chip (e.g. `ADR-007`). |
| `date` | — | ISO date string. Displayed as tabular-nums. No parsing — just shown as-is. |
| `title` | — | Decision title — rendered as H3 below the header. |
| `supersedes` | — | ADR id this replaces — shown on the right side of the header. |
| `superseded-by` / `supersededBy` | — | ADR id that replaces this one. |

### Status → tone

| status | tone | color |
|---|---|---|
| proposed | info | blue |
| accepted | success | green |
| rejected | danger | red |
| deprecated | muted | gray |
| superseded | warn | amber |

### Body

Free-form markdown. Children render through react-markdown normally —
conventional pattern is H3s for Context / Decision / Consequences, but
nothing is enforced. ADR authors can nest any MDX component inside
(tables, callouts, even a datagrid).

---

## 3. Pipeline

Both components slot into `MDXViewer.components` by lowercased tag name:

```
<Stats> / <Stat> / <ADR>
  ──▶ rehype-raw turns the inline HTML into hast elements
  ──▶ react-markdown dispatches tag → components map
  ──▶ { stats: Stats, stat: Stat, adr: ADR } in MDXViewer.tsx
  ──▶ component renders its own Tailwind JSX
```

No remark plugins, no new fence languages, no info-string grammar.

---

## 4. Styling

- **Tailwind utilities first** — per `CLAUDE.md` §Styling. No `fv-*`
  classes except one (`fv-adr-body`) reserved for future MDX body
  typography hooks if needed.
- **shadcn tokens** for neutral color (`bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`,
  `border`).
- **Semantic colors via `TONE_CLASS`** imported from `@filemark/datagrid`
  — same idiom as status pills / tag chips / filter badges across the
  rest of the project. This is the reason semantic greens/reds/ambers
  are centralized: one edit updates every tone-using component.

---

## 5. Non-goals

- **CSV-driven Stats (`<Stats src="./kpis.csv" />`).** Deferred. If a
  user has row data that's really a stat list, they can author the
  `<Stat>` elements directly — no real ergonomic win from CSV until
  there are many.
- **Inline sparkline / trendline in Stat.** Nice-to-have; sparkline
  already exists as a datagrid column type. Could pull in as an optional
  `trend-data=` attr later. Not MVP.
- **Icons in Stat.** Requires lucide (or similar) in `@filemark/mdx`,
  which isn't worth a new dep for one feature. Authors can embed an
  emoji in `title=`.
- **ADR index page / linked graph.** Each ADR is self-contained;
  cross-ADR navigation via conventional id references + markdown links.

---

## 6. Backlog (ranked)

### Tier A — small / useful

- **`count=` on `<Stat>`** — auto-formats numbers (thousands separator,
  currency, percent) based on a hint. Today authors format the string
  themselves.
- **Inline sparkline** — `<Stat trend-data="1,3,2,4,5,6">` renders a
  tiny inline sparkline (reuse datagrid's sparkline renderer).
- **Default `<ADR>` title = H1 child** — if `title=` isn't set, use the
  first H1 in children. Saves duplicating the title.

### Tier B — structural

- **`<Stats src="./kpis.csv">` CSV-driven variant** — each row becomes a
  `<Stat>`. Column mapping via `title-col=`, `value-col=`, `delta-col=`,
  `description-col=`, `intent-col=`. Reuses datagrid's `parseCSV`.
- **`<ADR.Context>` / `<ADR.Decision>` / `<ADR.Consequences>`** —
  optional structured sub-components for authors who want auto-numbered
  section headings + TOC anchors.
- **ADR id auto-linking** — if body prose mentions `ADR-012`, transform
  to an anchor link to `#adr-012`.

### Tier C — nice-to-have

- **Per-cell comparison** — `<Stat compare="$100,000">` shows delta
  automatically from current vs compare value.
- **Collapsible ADR** — `collapsed` attr; clicking header toggles.
- **ADR export** — "Copy ADR" button → MD string with the full block
  re-serialized.

---

## 7. Related docs

- `docsi/PLANNING_COMPONENTS.md` §1–4 — source of the design thesis.
- `docsi/ROADMAP.md` pillar 4 (writing / reading UX) + pillar 1 (data).
  Stats + ADR finish the first-slice quartet alongside chart + kanban.
- `docsi/DATAGRID.md` — where `TONE_CLASS` + `StatusTone` originate.
- `docsi/ARCHITECTURE.md` §11 — MDX component-dispatch pattern.
